signals: If I fail, it means I'm stupid.
I always wait until the last minute.
patterns.likely_need: Worth/performance decoupling and low-risk first action.
patterns.recommended_reframe: Performance is data. Worth is not up for review.

signals: I do not know what I want.
I am scared to choose wrong.
patterns.likely_need: Narrow options and prototype rather than decide forever.
patterns.risk: Do not force permanent commitment before data exists.

signals: I keep fighting the same unchangeable thing.
patterns.recommended_reframe: This may be terrain, not a task.
patterns.risk: Do not invalidate real structural barriers.

signals: I know what to do but I cannot start.
I am waiting to feel ready.
patterns.recommended_reframe: Action creates motivation more reliably than waiting.
patterns.risk: Do not imply all barriers are solved by counting down.
